create_video_from_images: create a video from a list of numpy array images using imageio and FFMPEG
render_observation_to_image: render a habitat environment observation and info dict into a single composite frame image
tile_images_into_composite: tile multiple images of non-equal size into a single composite image arranged in columns
overlay_text_on_image: overlay lines of text on top of an image with automatic left and right column wrapping
overlay_info_on_frame: overlay flattened info dictionary key-value pairs as text on a frame image
